primary_sources.locator: Retained PMC13422317 main text, Methods enrichment design and Results MAG classification, flattened lines 56 and 60.
primary_sources.coverage: Selected retained main-text passages; no fresh complete supplement, MAG sequence or reference-assembly reanalysis.
anchors: MAG1 affiliated with a lineage within the genus Syntrophothermus

occurrences.source_assessment: The authors place MAG1 within Syntrophothermus and propose Candidatus Syntrophothermus ammoniitolerans. The existing canonical descriptor remains genus rank; the provisional species name and MAG1 identity are preserved.
occurrences.population_scope: Five filtered reference genomes support the same genus. They are not five study MAGs, replicates, or exact sequence matches for MAG1.
occurrences.name_scope: No promotion of the proposed species to an existing reference species and no assembly identity or expression/flux inference.

occurrences.source_assessment: The paper assigns MAG3 to Candidatus Methanoculleus thermohydrogenotrophicum. The exact-ID reference correspondence applies to that existing species descriptor, not a new identification of the study assembly.
occurrences.population_scope: Thirteen filtered reference genomes share the native GTDB species. This denominator is neither study abundance nor a set of verified MAG3 assembly matches.
occurrences.name_scope: Preserve the Candidatus source name, MAG3 designation and archaeal domain; add no measured hydrogen/formate flux or partner-specific causal assertion.

occurrences.source_assessment: The single canonical genus entry represents source-assigned Methanothermobacter wolfeii MAG4 and Methanothermobacter tenebrarum MAG5. Its combined designation is retained without collapsing their biological distinction.
occurrences.population_scope: The 44/44 reference-genome genus correspondence is not a single stock, 44 study genomes, or the measured archaeal read fraction.
occurrences.name_scope: Retain genus rank and both MAG designations; do not choose one reference species or infer a direct genome match for either MAG.

records.historical_guard_assessment: Preserve MAG2's existing domain block and putative acetate-oxidation uncertainty, four descriptors representing five MAGs, single long-running 0B culture, unsuccessful transfer limitation and separate replicated YB/control series. Existing metabolic genes and proposed exchanges remain inference rather than direct flux. Batch51's exact predecessor hash and old last-llm event require strict admission; retain its other two records, source-cache hashes and all current biological predicates.
